name: Template is empty
eba_ref: e23674_e, e23675_e, e23676_e, e23677_e, e23680_e, e23682_e, e23683_e, e23792_e; 808 (e23681_e for B_07.01 is inactive since March 2025, still checked here)
fix: Report the template with at least one row; every template is expected in the package.

name: Mandatory field is blank
fix: Fill the field from the contract file or the entity master data.

name: Duplicate key
fix: Keep one row per key; merge or delete the duplicate.

name: LEI has the wrong format
fix: An LEI has 18 letters or digits (upper case) followed by 2 check digits. Copy it from the GLEIF record.

name: LEI check digits are wrong
fix: The ISO 17442 check digits do not match: a typo. Copy the LEI from the GLEIF record.

name: Country code is not ISO 3166-1 alpha-2
fix: Use the 2-letter code (GB, not UK; DE, not DEU).

name: Currency code is not ISO 4217
fix: Use the 3-letter code (EUR, USD).

name: Provider code does not match its declared type
fix: Declare LEI for a 20-character LEI and EUID for a code like DEK1101R.HRB123456, and fix the value if it is neither.

name: Value is not in the closed list
fix: Pick one of the allowed values (see the reference lists).

name: Date is not a valid yyyy-mm-dd date
fix: Use ISO format yyyy-mm-dd and a real calendar date.

name: Number is not a whole number or amount
fix: Enter digits only (no text, units or thousands separators).

name: Amount is negative
fix: Expenses and total assets cannot be negative. Check the sign or the source.

name: End date is not after the start date
fix: Correct the dates against the signed contract.

name: Date is after the reporting date
fix: An assessment, audit or update cannot be dated after the reference date. Correct the date.

name: Entity lifecycle dates are inconsistent
fix: Order must be integration <= last update and integration <= deletion.

name: Termination reason without an end date
fix: Add the end date, or remove the reason if the contract is still running.

name: Amount reported without a currency
fix: Add the currency of the amount.

name: Subsequent arrangement has no overarching reference
fix: Fill the reference number of the master agreement.

name: Branch flag and branch code disagree
fix: Give the branch code when the entity using the service is a branch; leave it empty otherwise.

name: Hard to substitute, no reason given
fix: Explain why the provider is not substitutable or only with high complexity.

name: Critical function without reasons
fix: State why the function is critical or important (DORA Art. 3 definition of a critical or important function).

name: Alternatives flagged but none identified
fix: Name the alternative providers, or set the flag to false.

name: Data stored but no storage location
fix: Give the country of the data at rest, or set storage to false.

name: Contract reference not found in B_02.01
fix: Fix the reference, or add the contract to B_02.01.

name: Entity LEI not found in B_01.02
fix: Fix the LEI, or add the entity to B_01.02.

name: Provider code not found in B_05.01
fix: Fix the code, or add the provider (or the sub-contractor, or the parent) to B_05.01.

name: Function not found in B_06.01
fix: Fix the function identifier, or add the function to B_06.01.

name: Assessment or supply chain row has no matching contract row
fix: The contract, provider and service type must exist together in B_02.02.

name: Overarching reference does not point to a master agreement
fix: Point to a contract of type Overarching/master agreement that exists in B_02.01.

name: Branch code not found in B_01.03
fix: Fix the branch code, or add the branch to B_01.03 under its head office.

name: Contract missing from a template that must list it
fix: Every contract needs rows in B_03.01 and B_03.02; contracts other than master agreements also in B_02.02 and B_04.01.

name: Provider in B_02.02 is not the one in B_03.02
fix: The provider that signs the contract (B_03.02) must be the provider of the service (B_02.02).

name: Provider is not used by any contract
fix: Remove the provider, or add the contract that uses it. A provider that is only an ultimate parent is allowed.

name: Assessment missing, or present for a non-critical function
fix: B_07.01 is completed for contracts supporting critical or important functions, and only for those.

name: Level of reliance inconsistent with criticality
fix: Fill the level of reliance for services supporting a critical function, and leave it empty for the others.

name: Critical, hard to substitute, and no exit plan
fix: DORA Art. 28(8) expects an exit strategy for critical services. Confirm the plan exists or set it up.

name: Provider total expense differs from the sum of its contracts
fix: Reconcile B_05.01 total expense with the contract expenses in B_02.01 (same currency).

name: Supply chain is inconsistent
fix: Ranks must run 1, 2, 3 without gaps, and a provider cannot be its own sub-contractor.

name: Provider group takes a large share of ICT spend
fix: Review the dependency and the exit options for this provider group.

name: Provider group supports many critical functions
fix: Check whether one outage could hit several critical functions at once.

name: High spend share under one non-EU jurisdiction
fix: Review the third-country dependency (ultimate parent country).

name: Critical function depends on a single provider
fix: Document the alternative or the exit route for this function.
